home.heroSubtitle: Proclaiming the lordship of Christ and gathering in worship, prayer, and the Word.
home.whoWeAreLead: We are a church in Irving, Texas, where you can draw near to God in worship, prayer, and the Word. We are glad to welcome you as you are.
home.pastorWelcome: At the end of the message, the pastor personally welcomes visitors, and you can greet him after the service.
home.whatToExpectLead: We want you to feel at home from the moment you arrive. Here's what to expect when you visit us.
home.expect1Text: A time of praise, preaching, and prayer. The Sunday service usually lasts about 2 hours.
home.expect2Text: At the end of the message, the pastor personally welcomes visitors, and you can greet him after the service.
home.expect3Text: Children's ministry (ages 3–10) on Sundays during the message, and youth participation/gathering every 3rd Sunday.
home.locationTitle: We look forward to seeing you in Irving
